public_rationale: T2I-CompBench, released July 12, 2023, reports that coarse image-text similarity metrics miss fine-grained attribute-binding and spatial-relation errors [e1]. GenEval, released October 17, 2023, finds poor performance across tested models on relative positioning and attribute binding; the best results were only 15% and 35% correct, respectively [e2]. These findings support the capability-gap reading of the claim, although they establish detailed prompt-following failures more directly than convincing visual appearance [e1, e2].
limitations: The cited excerpts measure convincing visual appearance only indirectly.
The assessment interprets 'easier' as a capability gap; neither study compares computational cost or human effort.
The studies do not cover every generator or exhaustively test physical consistency, including anatomy.
The January 2023–January 29, 2024 assessment window was chosen by the evaluator, not specified by Marcus.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: For image generation, producing a seemingly coherent image is easier than ensuring it is actually coherent and consistent with the prompt.

statement.excerpt: It is easier to draw a seemingly coherent image than it is to make sure that the image actually is coherent and consistent with the prompt.

from_speaker: actually is coherent and consistent with the prompt
our_interpretation: The ordinary contextual reading is a capability gap: contemporary generators achieve convincing appearance more reliably than detailed scene consistency and complete prompt adherence.
This does not specify a comparison of runtime, financial cost, or human labor.

For this ongoing state, assess the latest completed calendar year of public evaluations and the period up to publication: January 2023 through January 29, 2024. This reporting window is an evaluator choice, not a period Marcus named.
The claim describes a general tendency, not failure on every image or every prompt.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous evaluations show visually convincing generated images alongside systematic failures in spatial relations, attribute binding, or other detailed prompt requirements.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evaluations show that convincing appearance reliably coincides with complete scene consistency and prompt adherence, without the claimed capability gap.
